summary: Lower && with JavaScript truthiness, short-circuiting, and operand-value return semantics.

target.notes: Evaluate left once. If ToBoolean(left) is false, return left unchanged; otherwise evaluate and return right.

caveats: C# && returns bool and is therefore not a general replacement.
Lambda lowering must not alter await/yield/control-flow semantics; compiler may need conditional-expression/statement lowering.

tests.name: edge returns falsy left and skips right
